rules_command: nft list chain inet filter ecpri-ip-filtering > /tmp/file2.txt
fhnftmgmt: oc get pods -n trs-cran33 | grep fhnftmgmt | cut -c 1-39
oamfh_ipsec: kubectl exec -it -n trs-cran33 po-trs-cran33-oamfh-0 -c ctr-trs-cran33-ipsecmgmt -- bash
healing_controller: oc get pods -n trs-cran33 | grep healing | cut -c 1-50
